chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from al-ʿAbbās, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام.
He was asked about a man who is in the middle of the crowd on Friday or on the Day of ʿArafah, and is unable to leave the masjid because of the large number of people.
He said: "He performs tayammum and prays with them, then repeats when he departs."

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the masjid where the prayer is being attended
key_terms.وَسْطِ الزِّحَامِ: the midst of a dense crowd
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: he performs tayammum as a substitute purification
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day of congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they cannot leave a crowded masjid to obtain water for purification?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who is trapped in a dense crowd in the masjid on Friday or the Day of ʿArafah and cannot go out. He is instructed to perform tayammum and pray with the congregation, then repeat the prayer after leaving.
